servinfo.title: Cylinder Head Cover Removal and Installation

s1.ptxt: Disconnect negative (–) cable at battery.
Remove air cleaner assembly and air cleaner outlet hose No.1.
Remove high pressure fuel pump cover.
Remove ignition coil assemblies.
Disconnect engine harness clamps (1).
Remove engine harness bracket bolts (2).
Remove engine cover bracket No.1 (3).
Remove oil level gauge (4).
Disconnect breather hose (5) from cylinder head cover.
Disconnect air bypass valve connector (6) and air bypass valve control hose No.3 (7).
Loosen cylinder head cover bolts No.1 (1) and No.2 (2) in numerical order (“1” – “14”) evenly and gradually.
Remove cylinder head cover with cylinder head cover gasket.
Remove oil, old sealant and dust from sealing surfaces on cylinder head and cover.
Install new gasket (2) to cylinder head cover (1).
Apply sealant “A” to the mating surface as shown.
Install cylinder head cover to cylinder head.

attention3.ptxt: When installing cylinder head cover, use care so that cylinder head cover gasket will not get out of place or fall off.

s1.ptxt: Tighten cylinder head cover bolts No.1 and No.2 according to the following procedure.

s2.ptxt: Temporarily tighten cylinder head cover bolts No.1 (1) to position the cylinder head cover.
Tighten cylinder head cover bolts No.1 and No.2 to 5.0 N·m (0.51 kgf-m, 4.0 lbf-ft) in numerical order (“1” – “14”) evenly and gradually.
Retighten cylinder head cover bolts No.2 to 10 N·m (1.0 kgf-m, 7.5 lbf-ft) and cylinder head cover bolts No.1 to 7.5 N·m (0.76 kgf-m, 5.5 lbf-ft) in the same manner as in Step b).

torqueitem.t-note: 5.0 N·m → 7.5 N·m (0.51 kgf-m → 0.76 kgf-m, 4.0 lbf-ft → 5.5 lbf-ft)
5.0 N·m → 10 N·m (0.51 kgf-m → 1.0 kgf-m, 4.0 lbf-ft → 7.5 lbf-ft)

s1.ptxt: Connect air bypass valve control hose No.3 (7) and air bypass valve connector (6).
Connect breather hose (5) to cylinder head cover.
Install oil level gauge (4).
Install engine cover bracket No.1 (3).
Tighten engine harness bracket bolts (2).
Connect engine harness clamps (1).
Install ignition coil assemblies.
Install high pressure fuel pump cover.
Install air cleaner outlet hose No.1 and air cleaner assembly.
Connect negative (–) cable at battery.
